facts.projectName: Biscuit Belly (replacing Maple Street Biscuit Company)
facts.quote: The Hamlin location at 16027 New Independence Pkwy #100 will remain open and transition to a Biscuit Belly within the next 18-24 months. According to Biscuit Belly's preliminary conversion schedule, the Hamlin restaurant is expected to make the change during the third quarter of 2028.

newProject.summary: Hamlin's Maple Street Biscuit Company stays open and will be rebranded as a Biscuit Belly after Cracker Barrel sold the chain.
newProject.description: Cracker Barrel sold Maple Street Biscuit Company; 16 locations closed nationwide, but the Hamlin restaurant at 16027 New Independence Pkwy #100 is among the 35 that stay open and convert to the Biscuit Belly brand. Conversions begin in January 2027 and Hamlin is tentatively scheduled for the third quarter of 2028.

Plans were filed recently with the county by Kelly, Collins & Gentry, on behalf of Boyd Development, for the next phase of construction on about 20 acres of land across two lots near the intersection of Avalon Road and Porter Road. The 9-acre lot at the corner of Avalon and Lake Hamlin Trail will add two 12,000-square-foot buildings and four 5,000-square-foot buildings, with preleasing to start by mid- to late 2026 and delivery targeted for 2027.

newProject.summary: Six new medical office buildings (two 12,000 sq ft and four 5,000 sq ft) on 9 acres at Avalon Road and Lake Hamlin Trail, delivery targeted for 2027.
newProject.description: Boyd Development filed plans with Orange County for the next phase of the Hamlin medical offices project on about 20 acres near Avalon Road and Porter Road. The 9-acre lot at Avalon Road and Lake Hamlin Trail adds two 12,000-square-foot and four 5,000-square-foot buildings; preleasing starts mid-to-late 2026 with delivery in 2027. A later phase calls for a 93,573-square-foot self-storage facility and two 10,000-square-foot office buildings.

location.description: Avalon Road & Lake Hamlin Trail (9-acre lot), near Avalon Road & Porter Road
